what: Twelve rows copied verbatim, unaltered, from one live response of the public UsePod marketplace feed. Only row selection was applied; no field was edited, added or removed.
source: GET https://api.usepod.ai/v1/marketplace/models (public, no credential; the endpoint the usepod.ai/marketplace page reads)
selection: eight named per-token and per-request rows: c0mpute-pro, claude-haiku-4-5, claude-sonnet-5, deepseek-v4-flash, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-oss-20b, kimi-k2, supergemma4-26b
the first two per-token rows with marketplace_provider_count 0 and a centralized price (bge-base-en-v1-5, deepseek-coder-33b-instruct)
the first per-token row with no prices at all (anthropic-claude-opus-4-7)
the first row with a non-text modality (dall-e-2)
unit_cross_check: gpt-oss-20b cheapest_input_per_1m 1600 and claude-haiku-4-5 77138 matched the rendered marketplace table ($0.0016 and $0.0771 per million) in the same session.
use: Schema and value-shape fixture only. These prices are historical observations and authorize nothing; tests that need hostile or changed values build SYNTHETIC rows and label them in the test.
